verdict.rationale: llamafile's built-in server documents HTTP server, API, and Web UI options side by side, and the Web UI is served at localhost:8080, so a programmatic API surface exists alongside the UI. Nothing in the evidence shows that every UI action is also reachable through the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint reference, explicit evidence of UI/API feature parity (e.g., image upload and chat via API), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
just open a browser window and connect to http://localhost:8080/
